newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner sup board approves dividend rise.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner sup board approves dividend rise.

text.p: Dresdner Bank AG said on Tuesday its supervisory board had approved the management's proposal to pay a dividend of 1.45 marks for 1996, up from 1.35 marks, plus a bonus of 0.10 marks per share to celebrate the bank's 125th anniversary.
The bank announced the management board's dividend proposal in February.
Dresdner said the dividend payout for 1996 will total 724.4 million marks, up more than 20 percent from the year before.
The allocation to earnings reserves will total 812.9 million marks, up from 570.6 million marks, the bank said in a statement.
Dresdner will detail 1996 earnings at a news conference on Thursday. The bank's annual shareholder meeting is on May 23.
